description: Loan payments whose GL allocations (75% principal, 25% interest) land exactly on half a cent, e.g. 0.50 x 0.25 = 0.125. Banker's rounding gives 0.12; rounding half away from zero would give 0.13. Includes 4.70 x 0.25 = 1.175, which rounds differently in binary floating point (ADR 0006).
